mapper.select: SELECT enquete_table.id as enqueteId, enquete_title as enqueteTitle, question_table.id as questionId, question_table.question_text as questionText, answer_table.id as answerId, answer_table.answer_text as answerText FROM enquete_table INNER JOIN question_table ON enquete_table.id = question_table.enquete_id INNER JOIN answer_table ON question_table.id = answer_table.question_id ORDER BY enqueteId ASC

SELECT enquete_table.id as enqueteId, enquete_title as enqueteTitle, question_table.id as questionId, question_table.question_text as questionText, answer_table.id as answerId, answer_table.answer_text as answerText FROM enquete_table INNER JOIN question_table ON enquete_table.id = question_table.enquete_id INNER JOIN answer_table ON question_table.id = answer_table.question_id WHERE enquete_table.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO result_table ( enquete_id, question_id, answer_id, user_id) VALUES (#{enqueteId}, #{questionId}, #{answerId}, #{userId})
INSERT INTO question_table ( enquete_id, question_text) VALUES (#{enqueteId}, #{questionText})
INSERT INTO answer_table ( question_id, answer_text) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{answerText})
mapper.select: SELECT id as enqueteId FROM enquete_table WHERE enquete_title = #{enqueteTitle}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enquete_table WHERE enquete_title = #{enqueteTitle}
SELECT id, user_name, password, authority FROM users_table ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users_table ( user_name, password, authority) VALUES (#{userName}, #{password}, #{authority})
mapper.update: UPDATE users_table SET user_name = #{userName}, password = #{password}, authority = #{authority} WHERE id = #{id}
